name: Valley Indoor Swap Meet - Panorama City
summary: Valley Indoor Swap Meet is a bustling indoor marketplace featuring hundreds of vendors selling apparel, shoes, and accessories at value prices. This popular Panorama City destination offers a vibrant shopping experience with diverse merchandise and a loyal community following.
demographics: Valley Indoor Swap Meet attracts a diverse, value-conscious demographic primarily from the San Fernando Valley's working-class and middle-income families. The customer base skews toward Hispanic and multi-generational households seeking affordable apparel, accessories, and household goods. Shoppers typically range from young families to seniors looking for bargain prices and a traditional marketplace atmosphere. The trade area draws heavily from Panorama City, Van Nuys, and surrounding North Valley neighborhoods with median household incomes below the Los Angeles County average.
description: Valley Indoor Swap Meet in Panorama City has served as a beloved shopping destination for San Fernando Valley residents seeking value and variety under one roof. Located on Parthenia Street, this indoor marketplace brings together hundreds of independent vendors offering an eclectic mix of apparel, shoes, accessories, and merchandise at competitive prices. The swap meet format creates a vibrant, bustling atmosphere reminiscent of traditional mercados, where shoppers can browse diverse offerings while discovering unique finds and negotiating deals. With operating hours from 10 AM to 6 PM and a strong 4.2-star rating from over 3,600 reviews, the center has built a loyal customer base that appreciates its one-stop shopping convenience and affordable pricing. The indoor setting provides year-round comfort while maintaining the energetic, community-oriented feel that has made swap meets a cultural institution in Southern California.
